package main

import (
	"bufio"
	"net"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"time"
)

// runningGone marks clients that Disconnect has already handled, so that a
// QUIT handler's Disconnect followed by serve's final Disconnect is harmless.
var runningGone sync.Map

// runningParse splits an IRC line into a Message plus the command exactly as
// the client sent it. ok is false for an empty line.
func runningParse(line string) (m Message, raw string, ok bool) {
	rest := strings.TrimLeft(line, " ")
	if strings.HasPrefix(rest, ":") {
		i := strings.IndexByte(rest, ' ')
		if i < 0 {
			return m, "", false
		}
		rest = rest[i+1:]
	}
	var toks []string
	for {
		rest = strings.TrimLeft(rest, " ")
		if rest == "" {
			break
		}
		if rest[0] == ':' && len(toks) > 0 {
			toks = append(toks, rest[1:])
			break
		}
		i := strings.IndexByte(rest, ' ')
		if i < 0 {
			toks = append(toks, rest)
			break
		}
		toks = append(toks, rest[:i])
		rest = rest[i+1:]
	}
	if len(toks) == 0 {
		return m, "", false
	}
	raw = toks[0]
	m.Command = strings.ToUpper(raw)
	m.Params = toks[1:]
	return m, raw, true
}

// runningDispatch handles one complete line. It takes s.mu itself.
// It returns true when the client has been disconnected.
func (s *Server) runningDispatch(c *Client, line string) bool {
	m, raw, ok := runningParse(line)
	if !ok {
		return false
	}
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	if !c.Registered {
		switch m.Command {
		case "NICK", "USER", "PING", "QUIT":
		default:
			c.Send(":" + serverName + " 451 * :You have not registered")
			return false
		}
	}
	h, found := handlers[m.Command]
	if !found {
		if c.Registered {
			c.Send(":" + serverName + " 421 " + c.Nick + " " + raw + " :Unknown command")
		}
		return false
	}
	h(s, c, m)
	_, gone := runningGone.Load(c)
	return gone
}

func (s *Server) runningServeBody(conn net.Conn) {
	c := &Client{
		channels: map[string]bool{},
		conn:     conn,
		out:      make(chan string, 256),
	}
	// Single writer goroutine: drains the queue, then closes the connection.
	go func() {
		failed := false
		for l := range c.out {
			if failed {
				continue
			}
			conn.SetWriteDeadline(time.Now().Add(10 * time.Second))
			if _, err := conn.Write([]byte(l)); err != nil {
				failed = true
			}
		}
		conn.Close()
	}()

	r := bufio.NewReaderSize(conn, 1024)
	var buf []byte
	over := false
loop:
	for {
		chunk, err := r.ReadSlice('\n')
		if !over && len(buf)+len(chunk) <= 600 {
			buf = append(buf, chunk...)
		} else {
			over = true
		}
		if err == bufio.ErrBufferFull {
			continue
		}
		if err != nil {
			break
		}
		line := string(buf)
		wasOver := over
		buf = buf[:0]
		over = false
		if wasOver {
			continue
		}
		line = strings.TrimSuffix(line, "\n")
		line = strings.TrimSuffix(line, "\r")
		if len(line) > 512 {
			continue
		}
		if s.runningDispatch(c, line) {
			break loop
		}
	}
	s.mu.Lock()
	s.Disconnect(c, "Connection closed")
	s.mu.Unlock()
	runningGone.Delete(c)
}

func (c *Client) runningSendBody(line string) {
	defer func() { recover() }() // queue may already be closed by Disconnect
	select {
	case c.out <- line + "\r\n":
	default:
		// Slow client: never block the server; drop the connection.
		c.conn.Close()
	}
}

func (s *Server) runningReplyBody(c *Client, code string, text string) {
	target := c.Nick
	if target == "" {
		target = "*"
	}
	c.Send(":" + serverName + " " + code + " " + target + " :" + text)
}

func (c *Client) runningPrefixBody() string {
	return c.Nick + "!" + c.User + "@" + serverName
}

func (s *Server) runningDisconnectBody(c *Client, reason string) {
	if _, loaded := runningGone.LoadOrStore(c, true); loaded {
		return
	}
	if c.Nick != "" {
		key := strings.ToLower(c.Nick)
		if s.clients[key] == c {
			delete(s.clients, key)
		}
	}
	peers := map[*Client]bool{}
	for name := range c.channels {
		ch := s.channels[name]
		if ch == nil {
			continue
		}
		for k, m := range ch.members {
			if m == c {
				delete(ch.members, k)
			} else {
				peers[m] = true
			}
		}
		if len(ch.members) == 0 {
			delete(s.channels, name)
		}
	}
	c.channels = map[string]bool{}
	if c.Registered {
		line := ":" + c.Prefix() + " QUIT :" + reason
		for p := range peers {
			p.Send(line)
		}
	}
	// The writer goroutine flushes what is queued, then closes the connection.
	close(c.out)
}
